lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible. The central two rows exhibit a staggered arrangement where spots in the second row are positioned roughly at the horizontal midpoint between spots in the first and third rows, creating a series of isosceles triangular clusters across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like appearance where the highest-intensity blobs serve as anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible. The primary ridge, situated in the upper third of the flank, exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with a light-reflecting superior edge and a deep-shadowed inferior edge, maintaining a near-linear trajectory toward the caudal peduncle.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin displays a unique high-density clustering of small-diameter spots, with the highest concentration occurring along the proximal leading edge, distinct from the larger spot patterns on the lateral flank.
